summary: Responsive design testing completed successfully for all requested pages. All responsive breakpoints working correctly - hamburger menu visible on mobile (<768px), full navigation on tablet/desktop (≥768px), and compact buttons on mobile screens.

hamburger_menu_mobile.details: Hamburger menu visible at 390px (mobile), hidden at 768px+ (tablet/desktop)

hamburger_menu_navigation.details: Mobile navigation sheet opens correctly with Home, My Coaches, Templates, Calendar, Settings, and Log Out options

appheader_full_nav_desktop.details: Full navigation buttons (Home, My Coaches, Templates, Calendar, Settings) visible on desktop (1920px)

mycoaches_responsive_header.details: Add Coach button shows icon-only on mobile, full text on desktop

sessionsetup_responsive_header.details: Start button shows 'Start' on mobile, 'Start Observation' on desktop

coachprofile_responsive_header.details: New Observation button shows icon-only on mobile, full text on desktop

settings_responsive.details: Settings page renders correctly on both mobile and desktop viewports

tablet_breakpoint_768px.details: At 768px (tablet), hamburger hidden and desktop nav visible

below_breakpoint_767px.details: At 767px (below tablet), hamburger visible and desktop nav hidden

AppHeader.jsx.responsive_classes: Uses md:flex for desktop nav, md:hidden for hamburger menu, sm: breakpoints for sizing

SessionSetup.jsx.responsive_classes: Uses sm:inline for 'Start Observation' text, icon-only on mobile
